name: @ggui-ai/e2e-guuey-integration
description: Standing keyless interop proof for the ggui × guuey render channel (ggui#429): ggui's card surfaces consumed through guuey's published SDK (@guuey/threads + @guuey/mcp-apps-host at EXACT pins) with zero hosted infrastructure. The matrix: live mount via a real in-process ggui server over the real MCP wire, persist→rehydrate equivalence through guuey's extracted ThreadStore, the provider-raw ui:// channel on both arms, the locator-placeholder invariant for persisted ggui renders (bootstrap-free rows, wsToken never persists — guuey#122/ggui#430), and rehydrate-by-refetch minting fresh credentials. The @guuey/* pins are exact because the suite tests ggui HEAD against the versions guuey actually shipped; the pins are dev-side test harness only — no published @ggui-ai/* package depends on anything above MCP.
